title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: Withholding Proposal Rates After a Denied Waiver
content:
A waiver already refused on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** sets a denial rate on the monthly withholding proposed on a reduced-withholding request.

**Rule.** When a waiver decision of denied was recorded on the debt in the last six calendar months and a request with a Financial Status Report was received on the debt in that period, the denial-with-report rate of 85 percent applies. When a waiver was denied in that period and no such report was received, the plain denial rate of 95 percent applies. Otherwise no denial rate applies.

A denied waiver is a waiver decision recorded on the debt with the outcome denied, dated by its decision date. A request with a report is any request on the debt recorded with a Financial Status Report attached. A record falls in the last six calendar months when fewer than six whole calendar months have passed from its date to today: on 20 October, 21 April counts and 20 April does not. The denial rate is a percentage by which the starting figure of the proposal is multiplied before the proposal is rounded up to the cent.

| Waiver denied in the period | Request with a report in the period | Denial rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 85 percent |
| Yes | No | 95 percent |
| No | Either | None |

**Hypothetical case.** A waiver denied three months ago on a request that had a report attached and was received four months ago: 85 percent. A waiver denied seven months ago: none.
